title: demolish_button_rect grew a nil-default View param — two geometries from one helper, and a parity caller already uses the unscaled one
detail: The optional nil fallback reintroduces exactly the draw/hit-test divergence the hud() single-source rule exists to prevent. parity.odin's pipe path already hits the unscaled variant; it only coincides today because parity runs at x1.00.
recommended_fix: Make the View param required and pass it at the parity call site (pipe_demolish_btn_center already receives `view`). Delete the unscaled fallback branch.

title: crisis_card_width hardcodes the forecast panel's width constants (230/10) — cross-module layout knowledge duplicated in crisis.odin
evidence:
forecast_left := v.win_w - hud(v, 230) - hud(v, 10) // the forecast panel's left edge
max_right := forecast_left - hud(v, 10)             // a 10px gap keeps them apart
detail: crisis.odin now embeds forecast.odin's card width and padding literals. A future forecast resize silently invalidates the banner clamp with no compiler or test signal.
recommended_fix: Hoist the forecast card width/pad into named shared constants (or a forecast_left_edge(v) helper in forecast.odin) consumed by both modules.

title: AUDIO panel row triggers settings_save despite mute not being persisted — dead disk write and a non-round-tripping row
detail: The mute toggle writes a settings file whose payload (palette/motion/scale) did not change, and the AUDIO row's state is lost on relaunch while its sibling rows persist — inconsistent persistence surface.
recommended_fix: Skip settings_save for the AUDIO row (or persist mute in a v2 field); document the row as session-only in the panel comment.
